programming.title: Programming Fundamentals
programming.content: Programming is the process of creating computer software using programming languages like Python, Java, and JavaScript.

python.title: Python Programming Language
python.content: Python is a high-level, interpreted programming language known for its simplicity and readability.

artificial intelligence.title: Artificial Intelligence (AI)
artificial intelligence.content: AI is the simulation of human intelligence in machines programmed to think and learn.

machine learning.title: Machine Learning
machine learning.content: Machine learning is a subset of AI that enables computers to learn without explicit programming.
